instruction: In 2019, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) found that the following EU/EEA countries had measles cases exceeding 100: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, France, Germany, Italy, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, and Spain. Which of these countries had second-dose coverage of a measles-containing vaccine below 90% (according to WUENIC data) and a GDP per capita (World Bank data) below the EU average in 2019?
